fields.title: 📖 They kill the Muslims and leave the idolaters
fields.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“They kill the people of Islam and leave the people of the idols.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** A mark of extreme deviation is that hatred against Muslims becomes stronger than the clear enmity against shirk and kufr.

immutable.source: 📝 Muslim, Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim, Kitāb az-Zakāh, Bāb: Dhikr al-Khawārij wa-ṣifātihim, Hadith Nr. 1064.
